purpose: Additional one-at-a-time cinematic state-specific candidates, kept separate from the fifteen primary scene cards

shotCard.focus: a single aged industrial protection-terms letter bearing an illegible ink signature and dark red wax seal is lifted by an investigator wearing black leather gloves directly above a separate open factory verification ledger, while an older proprietor's signet-ringed hand rests nearby without a pen
shotCard.camera: low medium-close three-quarter viewpoint centered on the signed paper suspended in gloved hands above the thick verification register, with both people's faces outside the frame
shotCard.location: a wealthy factory owner's dark wood-paneled private office in industrial Birmingham during the 1920s
required: one weathered formal paper held up in dark leather gloves, visibly bearing a single flowing illegible ink signature and a small red wax seal near its lower edge
a separate open bound register flat on the wooden table with another decorative red wax impression and neat archival lines
a mature bare hand with a gold signet ring resting away from the paper on the opposite side of the desk
shotCard.background: worn dark oak table, brass lamp, tall rain-streaked window with smoking brick factory chimneys beyond, burgundy curtains and an old leather chair
shotCard.light: warm amber brass-lamp light on yellowed paper and wax against cool blue rain-lit industrial skyline
shotCard.npc: only the investigator's black-gloved hands and the older industrial owner's hand; no new visible facial likeness
shotCard.knowledgeBoundary: This image is for the signed scene state only after the scenario has separately verified backing of a pledge and a safe place for at least one witness. A signed paper does not itself prove all witnesses rescued, the owner personally signed it, or guilt admitted.
avoid: any readable signature identifying a real person or invented witness address
the seated proprietor holding the pen or personally signing the paper
a signed confession of murder, court verdict or triumphant handshake
witnesses shown rescued or protected simply because a page has a wax seal
a face replacing the established proprietor or the playable investigator
